lines.en: My feet hit the ground heavily.
Each step leaves a shallow pit.
I walk ahead of you.
Arms hanging, brushing the grass.
I push the bush out of the way.
Iron legs, step by step, never resting.
My joints grind.
I turn sideways to pass the tree.
I stop; the ground still rings.
A layer of dust sits on my shoulder.
One step per block, steady.
My shadow covers the whole path.

lines.zh: 我把脚踩实了再抬另一只。
lines.en: I plant a foot before lifting the other.
I come down the low slope.
I stand beside you.
My neck turns half around and stops.
I scan the front.
My fists hang to my knees.
I stand still as an iron frame.

lines.zh: 我的传感器抓着远处的响。
lines.en: My sensors hold a distant sound.
My old rust creaks.
I lift a hand slowly.
I count living things around us.
I shift my weight.
I stand like an iron post.
My shoulders drop.

lines.zh: 我把脖子转过去看后面。
lines.en: I turn my neck to look behind.
The wind cools my iron shell.
I am here, right beside you.
Shall I stand in front?
I have to look down to see you.
I know your voice.
Standing is its own kind of waiting.
My arms can be a shield.
Speak; I listen.
There is something ahead. I see it.
Stand behind me.
My fist is bigger than you.
You take a step; I take a step.
One command and I move.
I give half a pace and settle.
A spark spits from the dent.
The plating dents; I still walk.
I square my frame up again.
A gear catches; I keep going.
I straighten slowly.
Plate dented; I can still block.
I shake the rubble off my shoulder.
My arm is a little slow.
Get past my arm's reach.
Food is just clutter to me.
That thing won't buy fuel.
Iron, though, I could take.
Set it down; I won't touch it.
Too small for two of my fingers.
I can't see the use.
Any other iron on you?
I picked it up.
This frame lacks nothing here.
Use it yourself.
You hit iron and bounce back.
I didn't move. You were pushing.
My body is iron.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进土里，你撞上。
lines.en: My feet sink into the soil; you hit them.
I shift half a body's width.
We knock with a metal clang.
I put out a hand and caught you.
You hit iron; you're the one hurting.
I turn and yield half a step.
Steady — don't stand under my feet.
I am an iron block that was summoned.
Iron and iron only rust.
You didn't call me for that.
Standing here will do.
I let my hands hang.
You order, I do.
Standing like this will do.
Don't come too close; I'm cold.
Iron doesn't talk about such things.
I'm still here. I haven't left.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，关节响，铁锈掉了一地。
lines.en: I bend over; joints creak and rust flakes fall.
I can hold this.
Too small for my grip.
Does my master want this?
I can't pocket it; you take it.
This sounds like metal.
I'll carry it over for you.
I keep what falls.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，把它搁在你脚边。
lines.en: I bend and set it by your feet.
This isn't heavy to me.
Enemy ahead.
My master points; I go block it.
My arm rises, locked on it.
Get behind me.
I measured its distance.
It's coming closer.
One punch will drive it back.
My feet are planted.
My optic is on it.
Wait for my signal.
It's in range.
My arm is in position.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去挡住路。
lines.en: I turn side-on to block the way.
My knuckles creak.
It's three blocks off.
I have counted its breaths.
I close one block per step.

lines.zh: 它绕到侧面的意图我看懂了。
lines.en: I read its intent to flank.
I push it toward the wall.

lines.zh: 它的攻击打在我手臂上。
lines.en: Its blow lands on my arm.
I don't give ground. You're behind me.
Your left is open; I fill it.
It retreats; my arms extend.
I wait for it to err.
Come in and finish.
It turned to you.
My big hand closes.
I'm striking. Don't stand in front.
I press in, one block at a time.
It hits my arm. Nothing.
I keep you behind me.
My arm bars its path.
My fist lands and the earth shakes.
My arm sweeps across.
That cracked the ground.
It is knocked back.
I seize its shoulder.
I put my full weight into it.
It hit my chest and fell back.
I press down with my hand.
You go. I'll pin it.
It's nearly done.
I drive it into the dirt.
My palm lands on its chest.
I press it down to the ground.

lines.zh: 它的攻击打在我铁壳上。
lines.en: Its blow rings off my iron shell.
I was summoned here.
My feet sink into the soil.
I looked at you first.
You smell rust before you see me.
I stood up, joints locked.
My joints unlock one by one.
I test my arm.
The ground takes my print.
I hear a sound far off.
I walk to your side.
I await your orders.
I wait for your first word.
My shadow falls on the ground.
My knees bend once.
Fire bakes my iron shell hot.
I fell; my legs absorbed it.
Water gets into my joint gaps.
The blast tore off a plate.
Something is lodged in my chest.
Spell-light makes my iron heavy.
I have no stomach; I can't starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在铁上，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning on iron numbs me all over.
The void drags me down.
